connector.name: MADB - Agent Memory Database
connector.registryDescription: Durable causal memory for AI agents - semantic recall, causal lineage, and skills. Local-first.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package madb-mcp-server. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the spshkar84 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MADB_DATA_DIR
env.description: Where MADB stores your causal memory — local, on your machine (default ~/.madb/data).

env.name: MADB_TENANT_ID
env.description: Tenant namespace key for separating memory streams (e.g. per project). Defaults to a built-in namespace.

env.name: MADB_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to 'off' to disable anonymous, count-only usage telemetry.
